# testing_name_shadowing (Resource)

NameShadowing Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_name_shadowing" "my_nameshadowing" {
  big = "...my_big..."
  container_object_for_json_array = {
    json = [
      {
        key   = "...my_key..."
        value = "...my_value..."
      }
    ]
  }
  json = "...my_json..."
  operations = {
    name = "...my_name..."
    operations = {
      id    = "...my_id..."
      label = "...my_label..."
    }
    status = "...my_status..."
  }
  time                        = "...my_time..."
  types                       = "...my_types..."
  z_requires_big_import       = 0.11
  z_requires_json_import      = "{ \"see\": \"documentation\" }"
  z_requires_sdk_types_import = "2020-08-24"
  z_requires_time_import      = "2022-03-22T19:30:46.099Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `big` (String) Shadows the math/big package from z_requires_big_import. Requires replacement if changed.
- `container_object_for_json_array` (Attributes) Container object for additional test cases of name shadowing. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--container_object_for_json_array))
- `json` (String) Shadows the encoding/json package from z_requires_json_import. Requires replacement if changed.
- `operations` (Attributes) Tests SDK package name (operations) as an object type to verify symbol naming does not collide with SDK imports. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operations))
- `time` (String) Shadows the time package from z_requires_time_import. Requires replacement if changed.
- `types` (String) Shadows the SDK types package from z_requires_sdk_types_import. Requires replacement if changed.
- `z_requires_big_import` (Number) Requires replacement if changed.
- `z_requires_json_import` (String) Requires replacement if changed.; Parsed as JSON.
- `z_requires_sdk_types_import` (String) Requires replacement if changed.
- `z_requires_time_import` (String) Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_name_shadowing.my_testing_name_shadowing
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_name_shadowing.my_testing_name_shadowing "..."
```
